about_short_description.short_description: Get your favourite artists and bands to town

product.name: Crowdfunding Campaigns
product.description: A platform feature that allows users to initiate and support campaigns to fund events featuring artists or bands, charging supporters only if the campaign meets its goals and the event is confirmed.

product.name: Event Listing
product.description: A service that allows artists, promoters, and venues to list upcoming events for public viewing and ticket sales on the platform.

product.name: Ticketing
product.description: A ticket management system that supports ticket sales, transfers, resales, and scanning for events hosted on the platform.

product.name: Venue Booking
product.description: A tool for venues to manage bookings and coordinate event scheduling through the platform.

product.name: Streaming Channel
product.description: A service that supports hosting and accessing online live or recorded arts and entertainment events through the platform.

product.name: Production Management Tools
product.description: A suite of tools including calendar, production organizer, guest list management, email communications, and analytics to support event planning and execution.
